dimensions.quote: Title & Abstract Title 1a State that the study is assessing one or more generative AI-driven chatbots for clinical evidence or health advice.
Introduction Background 2a State the scientific background, rationale, and healthcare context for evaluating the generative AI-driven chatbot(s), referencing relevant literature when applicable.
Methods Model Identifiers 3a State the name and version identifier(s) of the generative AI model(s) and chatbot(s) under evaluation
Results 10a Report the performance evaluation undertaken including the alignment between generative AI-driven chatbot output and ground truth or reference standard
Discussion 11a Interpret study findings in the context of relevant evidence.
